name: DFX Social Executor Node
description: A DFX social node with Telegram Bot API, X (Twitter), and Reddit integration. Provides components for sending messages via Telegram, fetching posts from X/Twitter, and fetching posts from Reddit subreddits and user profiles.
author: Droq Team

DFXTelegramComponent.description: Alias for DFXTelegramMessageComponent for backward compatibility with applications expecting DFXTelegramComponent.
DFXTelegramComponent.author: Droq Team

DFXTwitterPostsComponent.description: Component for fetching posts from X (Twitter) API. Supports fetching user tweets with various fields and expansions.
DFXTwitterPostsComponent.author: Droq Team

DFXRedditPostsComponent.description: Component for fetching posts from Reddit API. Supports fetching posts from subreddits and user profiles.
DFXRedditPostsComponent.author: Droq Team
